current_forecast.name: Overnight
current_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of rain showers after 3am. Cloudy. Low around 58, with temperatures rising to around 60 overnight. Northeast wind around 15 mph. Chance of precipitation is 30%. New rainfall amounts less than a tenth of an inch possible.

seven_day_forecast.name: Monday
seven_day_forecast.short_forecast: Chance Rain Showers then Mostly Cloudy
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of rain showers before 10am. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 69. Northeast wind 10 to 15 mph. Chance of precipitation is 50%. New rainfall amounts less than a tenth of an inch possible.

seven_day_forecast.name: Tuesday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Mostly sunny, with a high near 74. Northeast wind 10 to 15 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Wednesday
seven_day_forecast.short_forecast: Chance Rain Showers then Chance Showers And Thunderstorms
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of rain showers between 7am and 1pm, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms. Partly sunny, with a high near 74. East wind 10 to 20 mph. Chance of precipitation is 50%.

seven_day_forecast.name: Thursday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of showers and thunderstorms before 1pm, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 74. East wind around 15 mph, with gusts as high as 30 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Friday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A slight chance of rain showers before 7am, then a slight chance of showers and thunderstorms between 7am and 1pm, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms. Partly sunny, with a high near 77. East wind 10 to 15 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Saturday
seven_day_forecast.short_forecast: Slight Chance Rain Showers then Slight Chance Showers And Thunderstorms
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A slight chance of rain showers before 1pm, then a slight chance of showers and thunderstorms. Mostly sunny, with a high near 80. East wind 5 to 10 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Sunday
